subject: Discovery recap: Observability & Evals - PeakHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@peakhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: Observability & Evals - PeakHealth

Hi Jordan (and Sara),

Thanks again for taking the time today - really helpful conversation. Wanted to capture a short recap of the pain, goals, and immediate next steps so we're aligned. Please reply with any corrections.

1) Key pain points you shared
- Lack of end-to-end observability for LLM inference (hard to correlate model responses to infra traces)
- No production-grade evals / golden prompt sets to detect regressions after model updates
- Dashboards are infra-focused (Datadog) but missing LLM metrics (quality, prompt-level latency/cost, per-route regression alerts)
- No automated rollout guardrails / canary policies that consider quality regressions

2) Current stack (high level)
- Inference: AWS SageMaker-hosted endpoints + internal API layer
- Metrics/infra: Datadog for infra telemetry, internal logs for prompts/responses
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions for model deployments, manual rollback today

3) Success criteria for a pilot / POC
- Instrumentation: instrument tracing hooks so we can correlate request -> model -> downstream services within 1 week of integration
- Visibility: dashboard with per-route latency/cost and quality metrics for top 5 intents
- Quality guardrails: golden prompt sets and automated regression alerts (detect meaningful drop in intent-level accuracy within 24 hours of a bad deploy)
- Rollout policy: ability to automate canary rollouts with automatic rollback on quality regression AND manual override

4) Proposed next steps
- Share Redwood Observability Playbook + POC scope (attached) - outlines tracing hooks, dashboard templates, and eval harness.
- Schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with your ML infra and backend teams (Rishi + engineer from PeakHealth) - propose next week.
- Run a 4-week POC: onboarding/integration (week 1), dashboard + eval setup (week 2), live monitoring + regression tuning (weeks 3-4), review.
- Deliverables: dashboard templates, golden prompt sets for top intents, regression alert configs, rollout guardrail config, short SOW for procurement.

Attachments: redwood-observability-playbook.pdf, POC-outline-peakhealth.xlsx

Open questions for you
- Who from your infra/ML team will own the tracing hook integration?
- Any procurement timelines / internal approvals we should be aware of?
- Are there any regulatory or data residency constraints for traces/logs?

Happy to set the deep-dive. I'll loop in Monica from CS to coordinate the POC schedule and Rishi (solutions) for technical follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference - production-first LLM inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@peakhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability & Evals - PeakHealth

Thanks, Marissa - this is great and matches our notes. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Timeline: a 4-week POC sounds reasonable. We have a product release on 11/15, so ideally the POC should surface blockers before that.
- Ownership: I'll own the infra side but I'll need support from our ML team (Sara) to validate the golden prompts and evaluation criteria.
- Integration scope: will your tracing hooks require changes to our API layer or can they be deployed as sidecar-like instrumentation?
- Cost: can you provide a rough estimate for the POC (engineering hours + any Redwood-managed infra)? Procurement will need a ballpark to prioritize internally.

Also helpful to see sample dashboard templates and an example golden prompt set we can review with Sara. If you can share an SOW draft we can circulate to our procurement team.

On timing, are you available for a technical deep-dive Friday 10/23 10-11am PT?

Appreciate it - looking forward to the POC.

- Jordan
Jordan Lee
Director, ML Infrastructure | PeakHealth
jordan.lee@peakhealth.com

Great questions - quick answers inline: 
- Tracing hooks: we support both approaches. For minimal changes, we can provide a lightweight wrapper/sidecar that instruments request/response flows and emits structured traces. If you prefer native integration, our SDK can be dropped into your API layer - that typically takes a bit more dev time but gives richer context. We'll outline both options in the playbook.
- Cost estimate (ballpark POC): ~120 engineer-hours (Redwood + PeakHealth), Redwood-managed infra approx $2,500 for the POC telemetry/hosting. We'll refine in the SOW but this should be enough for procurement to prioritize.
- Dashboards & golden prompts: attached playbook includes dashboard templates and a sample golden prompt set for the 'billing inquiry' and 'appointment scheduling' intents.
- SOW: attaching a short draft SOW for review (SOW-draft-peakhealth.docx).

For the technical deep-dive, Friday 10/23 10-11am PT works for Rishi and me. Monica will help coordinate the calendar invite and list of technical attendees.

Next actions (I'll own):
- Monica to send calendar invite for 10/23 and request attendees (infra + ML + backend).
- I'll share the playbook + SOW (attached) and a short checklist for the tech deep-dive.
- Rishi will prepare our integration options doc & sample tracing snippet.

If that looks right I'll kick off the invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
